label: Loaded cProfile cost attribution; not uninstrumented response latency
dominance: Visibility, strength and stability together consume most instrumented wall time. The shared visibility.py _loading_condition function has six calls and 18.816661292 s cumulative across its visibility and lashing callers; this is not attribution of six calls to the visibility part. Numerical hull/tank equilibrium is shared hot work across parts; cumulative parent/child rows overlap and must not be added.

cached_base_report.reason: Full reports are bound to complete instance and plan hashes. A changed destination invalidates base report binding. A changed placement can affect every cargo-dependent part at all three voyage conditions, plus replay/count and active in-port checks. No dependency proof for replacing affected part results was established.
cached_base_report.persistent_reuse: Exact parameter parsing, canonical policy, hull geometry LRUs and interpolation stencils exist; immutable metadata/input contents participate in cache keys. Geometry owns full-precision submerged-state caches. They are numerical reuse, never a base verdict.
cached_base_report.per_evaluation_reuse: checker.perf.evaluation_cache supplies a fresh disposable context for each public full check; it is not a persistent base report cache.
cached_base_report.safe_claim: No full-check shortcut implemented. A screen that skips any required part is an incremental screen, not a full check.
